technical_instructions: Ensure global scroll behavior is smooth (consider Lenis or framer-motion).
In tailwind.config.js, add the custom fonts: Cormorant Garamond for serif/headings, Manrope for sans/body.
Add custom colors to tailwind config extend: brand-primary (#C6A87C), brand-surface (#F7F5F2), brand-border (#E5E0D8), brand-text (#1C1917).
Use Lucide-react for icons (minimal and elegant).
Forms should have custom styling (remove default Shadcn borders, use bottom borders only for inputs for a premium feel).
Testimonials can use large serif quotes.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for testing.
